card.name: Linking words before co-administered drugs
card.fires_on: The word 'of' or 'with' right after 'administration', 'conjunction' or a drug name, where the next word will name another drug. Also the 'S' of 'Sulfate' in Codeine or Morphine Sulfate product names.

modes.label: Linking word before second drug
modes.description: 'of' or 'with' after administration, coadministration or a drug name, introducing the interacting drug or drug class.

modes.description: The first letter of 'Sulfate' after Codeine or Morphine in product names.
